('• '+a.mobile+' •') : '• LibraryBook.co.in •'; // 3) Topbar company name + logo + LibraryBook.co.in subtitle var tbName = document.getElementById('tb-lib-name'); var tbSub = document.getElementById('tb-lib-sub'); if(tbName) tbName.textContent = displayName; if(tbSub) tbSub.textContent = 'LibraryBook.co.in'; // 4) Receipt header — dynamic library/agent naam var rcName = document.getElementById('rc-lib-name'); var rcSub = document.getElementById('rc-lib-sub'); if(rcName) rcName.textContent = displayName; if(rcSub) rcSub.textContent = 'LibraryBook.co.in'; // 5) Payment / QR page — UPI ID + QR Code image var pqr=document.getElementById('pay-qr'); if(pqr) pqr.src = a.qrCode || a.upiScreenshot || ADMIN_QR; var pupi=document.getElementById('pay-upi'); if(pupi) pupi.textContent = a.upi || a.upiId || ''; // 5b) Fee Payment page — same QR/UPI, autofilled, taaki student ko fee page par hi QR mil jaaye var fpqr=document.getElementById('fee-pay-qr'); if(fpqr) fpqr.src = a.qrCode || a.upiScreenshot || ADMIN_QR; var fpupi=document.getElementById('fee-pay-upi'); if(fpupi) fpupi.textContent = a.upi || a.upiId || '-'; // 6) Bank Transfer section var bn=document.getElementById('bk-name'); if(bn) bn.textContent = a.accountName || a.name || ''; var bno=document.getElementById('bk-no'); if(bno) bno.textContent = a.bank || ''; var bi=document.getElementById('bk-ifsc'); if(bi) bi.textContent = a.ifsc || ''; var bb=document.getElementById('bk-bank'); if(bb) bb.textContent = a.bankName || ''; var sc=document.getElementById('sc-number'); if(sc) sc.textContent = a.mobile ? ('Screenshot bhejein: '+a.mobile) : 'Screenshot bhejein: -'; // ═ Collect Fee modal is agent ka UPI/Bank data reuse karega ═ window.CURRENT_AGENT_DATA = a; } // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // 💰 COLLECT FEE — student se fee lein, seedha Agent ke // apne UPI/Bank account mein (upi://pay deep link, koi // backend/gateway zaroori nahi — turant kaam karta hai) // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════ function OPEN_COLLECT_FEE(btn){ var tr = btn.closest('tr'); if(!tr) return; var sid = tr.getAttribute('data-stu-id') || ''; var name = tr.getAttribute('data-name') || (tr.querySelector('strong')?tr.querySelector('strong').textContent:'') || ''; var batch = tr.getAttribute('data-b') || ''; var fee = tr.getAttribute('data-fee') || ''; document.getElementById('cf-stu-id').value = sid; document.getElementById('cf-stu-name').textContent = name + (sid?' ('+sid+')':''); document.getElementById('cf-stu-batch').textContent = 'Batch '+(batch||'—'); document.getElementById('cf-amount').value = fee || ''; document.getElementById('cf-mode').value = 'UPI'; var msg = document.getElementById('cf-msg'); if(msg) msg.style.display='none'; var a = window.CURRENT_AGENT_DATA || {}; var qr = document.getElementById('cf-qr'); if(qr) qr.src = a.qrCode || a.upiScreenshot || document.getElementById('pay-qr').src; var upiIdEl = document.getElementById('cf-upi-id'); if(upiIdEl) upiIdEl.textContent = a.upi || a.upiId || '—'; document.getElementById('cf-bk-name').textContent = a.accountName || a.name || '—'; document.getElementById('cf-bk-no').textContent = a.bank || '—'; document.getElementById('cf-bk-ifsc').textContent = a.ifsc || '—'; CF_MODE_CHANGE(); CF_UPDATE_UPI_LINK(); OM('collectfee'); } function CF_MODE_CHANGE(){ var mode = document.getElementById('cf-mode').value; document.getElementById('cf-upi-block').style.display = (mode==='UPI') ? 'block' : 'none'; document.getElementById('cf-bank-block').style.display = (mode==='Bank Transfer') ? 'block' : 'none'; if(mode==='UPI') CF_UPDATE_UPI_LINK(); } // upi://pay deep link banata hai — ye link khulte hi student ke UPI app mein // Agent ka UPI ID pehle se bhara hua aata hai, paisa seedha Agent ke account mein jaata hai. function CF_UPDATE_UPI_LINK(){ var a = window.CURRENT_AGENT_DATA || {}; var upi = a.upi || a.upiId || ''; var amount = document.getElementById('cf-amount').value || ''; var name = document.getElementById('cf-stu-name').textContent || 'Student'; var linkEl = document.getElementById('cf-upi-link'); if(!linkEl) return; if(!upi){ linkEl.removeAttribute('href'); return; } var payeeName = encodeURIComponent(a.accountName || a.name || 'Agent'); var note = encodeURIComponent('Fee: '+name); var url = 'upi://pay?pa='+encodeURIComponent(upi)+'&pn='+payeeName+'&am='+encodeURIComponent(amount)+'&tn='+note+'&cu=INR'; linkEl.setAttribute('href', url); } document.addEventListener('input', function(e){ if(e.target && e.target.id==='cf-amount') CF_UPDATE_UPI_LINK(); }); // Payment mil jaane par: student ka fee record backend mein save karo // (Admin Panel ke Fee Payment History mein turant dikhega). // 🔒 FIX: pehle yeh seedha Firebase (fee_records) mein likhta tha — agar // network thoda bhi kamzor ho, to Firebase ka callback kabhi-kabhi bilkul // fire hi nahi hota tha (na success, na error) — button hamesha ke liye // "⏳ Saving..." par atka reh jaata tha. Ab yeh backend ke // '/payments/fee' route (fetch-based, hamesha turant success ya clear // error deta hai) se save hota hai — kabhi hang nahi hota, aur Admin // Panel ki Fee Payment History mein bhi sahi jagah se dikhta hai. function CONFIRM_COLLECT_FEE(){ var sid = document.getElementById('cf-stu-id').value; var name = (document.getElementById('cf-stu-name').textContent||'').replace(/\s*\([^)]*\)\s*$/,''); var batch = document.getElementById('cf-stu-batch').textContent.replace('Batch ','').trim(); var amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cf-amount').value)||0; var mode = document.getElementById('cf-mode').value; var msg = document.getElementById('cf-msg'); if(!amount){ if(msg){ msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(163,45,45,.12)'; msg.style.color='#A32D2D'; msg.textContent='⚠️ Please enter the amount.'; } return; } var todayD = new Date(); var monthKey = todayD.getFullYear() + '-' + String(todayD.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'); if(msg){ msg.style.display='block'; msg.style.background='rgba(15,110,86,.1)'; msg.style.color='#0F6E56'; msg.textContent='⏳ Saving...'; } var saveBtn = document.querySelector('#pg-collectfee button[onclick="CONFIRM_COLLECT_FEE()"]'); if(saveBtn) saveBtn.disabled = true; API.post('/payments/fee', { studentId: sid, amount: amount, mode: mode, note: (mode==='UPI' ? 'Collected directly into the Agent UPI account' : mode+' collected from (Agent App)') + ' — Batch '+batch, status: 'paid', monthKey: monthKey }).then(function(){ if(msg){ msg.style.background='rgba(15,110,86,.12)'; msg.style.color='#0F6E56'; msg.textContent='The fee has been collected and recorded.'; } setTimeout(function(){ CM('collectfee'); }, 900); }).catch(function(err){ if(saveBtn) saveBtn.disabled = false; if(msg){ msg.style.background='rgba(163,45,45,.12)'; msg.style.color='#A32D2D'; msg.textContent='⚠️ '+(err.message||'Unable to save. Please try again.'); } }); } // ===== LOGOUT ===== function DO_LOGOUT() { if(!confirm('Do you want to log out?')) return; AUTO_LOGOUT_REDIRECT(); } // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ // 🔒 AUTO-LOGOUT (Session Timeout) — 6 minute tak koi mouse/keyboard/ // touch activity na ho to security ke liye automatically logout. // Login screen par (jab tak login na ho) yeh chalu nahi hota. // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ function AUTO_LOGOUT_REDIRECT(){ try{AnmolPortal.notifyLogout();}catch(e){} currentUser = null; AUTH_TOKEN = null; try{ RESTORE_PENDING_STAFF_ROWS(); var stbT = document.getElementById('stb'); if(stbT) stbT.querySelectorAll('tr[data-stu-id]').forEach(function(r){ r.parentNode.removeChild(r); }); }catch(e){} // 🆕 CRITICAL LOGOUT FIX: pehle yahan token/localStorage/sessionStorage // kabhi clear hi nahi hota tha — sirf currentUser=null hota tha, isliye // agla user isi browser mein dobara login karne par purana session/token // reuse kar sakta tha. Ab logout par sab kuch turant clear hota hai. try { localStorage.clear(); } catch(e){} try { sessionStorage.clear(); } catch(e){} window.location.replace(SHDL_HOME_URL); /* 🆕 replace() so the login page never re-enters the browser back/forward history — prevents any back-button bounce into a stale session, and avoids Netlify 404s on refresh */ } (function(){ var AUTO_LOGOUT_MS = 6 * 60 * 1000; // 6 minutes var logoutTimer = null; function doAutoLogout(){ if (!currentUser) return; // login hua hi nahi hai, timer ki zaroorat nahi try{ alert('⏱️ You have been logged out automatically for security reasons after 6 minutes of inactivity.'); }catch(e){} AUTO_LOGOUT_REDIRECT(); } function resetAutoLogoutTimer(){ if (logoutTimer) clearTimeout(logoutTimer); logoutTimer = setTimeout(doAutoLogout, AUTO_LOGOUT_MS); } ['mousemove','mousedown','keypress','touchstart','scroll','click'].forEach(function(evt){ document.addEventListener(evt, resetAutoLogoutTimer, {passive:true}); }); resetAutoLogoutTimer(); })(); // ===== USER MANAGEMENT ===== function LOAD_USERS_TABLE() { var tb = document.getElementById('users-tb'); if(!tb) return; var h = ''; var roleColors = { 'Agent':'background:#e6f0ff;color:#0d1e3d', 'App Manager':'background:#EEEDFE;color:#534AB7', 'Staff':'background:#f1f5f9;color:#374151', 'Accountant':'background:#E1F5EE;color:#0F6E56', 'Teacher':'background:#FAEEDA;color:#854F0B' }; var accessColors = { 'full':'background:#E1F5EE;color:#0F6E56', 'view':'background:#f1f5f9;color:#374151' }; USERS.forEach(function(u, i){ var rc = roleColors[u.role] || 'background:#f1f5f9;color:#374151'; var ac = accessColors[u.access] || accessColors.view; var ini = u.name.split(' ').map(function(p){return p[0]||'';}).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0,2); var avColors = ['avb','avg','avr','ava']; h += '' + ''+ini+''+u.name+'' + ''+u.user+'' + ''+u.role+'' + ''+(u.access==='full'?'Full Access':'View Only')+'' + '' + (u.user==='Anmol' ? 'Protected' : '') + '' + ''; }); tb.innerHTML = h; } function DEL_USER(idx) { var u = USERS[idx]; if(!u) return; if(!confirm(u.name+' ('+u.user+') — do you want to delete this record?')) return; USERS.splice(idx, 1); SYNC_USERS_TO_FB(); LOAD_USERS_TABLE(); alert(u.name+' has been deleted.'); } // Load users table when modal opens var _origOM = OM; OM = function(id) { _origOM(id); if(id==='user-mgmt') setTimeout(LOAD_USERS_TABLE, 50); }; window.addEventListener('load', function(){ genCaptcha(); });
